department: Department of Brain Sciences (Faculty of Medicine)

deadline.value: There is no fixed departmental deadline: funded projects set their own closing dates. For the President's PhD Scholarship (open to all nationalities), apply by 2 Nov 2026, 11 Jan 2027 or 1 Mar 2027 (23:59 UK time).
deadline.quote: Applicants who apply by 23:59 (UK time) 2 November 2026 and are awarded a scholarship will be notified by 31 January 2027. | Applicants who apply by 23:59 (UK time) 11 January 2027 | Applicants who apply by 23:59 (UK time) 1 March 2027

also.quote: Complete Imperial College’s online application by the deadline stated on The President’s PhD Scholarship Webpages.

supervisor.value: First find and speak to a supervisor, and apply online only once they have agreed to supervise you; every PhD student has two supervisors. All successful applicants are interviewed.
supervisor.quote: Once you have found a supervisor who has agreed to supervise you, please apply online by clicking on ‘Apply for Doctoral Courses’. | The first step in the application process is to identify and speak to a supervisor.

funding.value: Funding usually comes from Wellcome Trust or MRC DTP fellowships, advertised funded projects or the President's Scholarship. Many project studentships pay only UK Home-rate fees, so overseas applicants must cover the fee difference.
funding.quote: Funding is often secured through Wellcome Trust or MRC DTP Fellowships. | Course fees at the UK Home-rate per year. Funding for overseas fees is not provided.

entry_route.value: Advertised projects ask for a first or 2:1 honours degree (or equivalent) in the biomedical sciences or a related subject; a master's is desirable but not required.
entry_route.quote: Applicants must hold, or be expected to obtain, a First or Upper Second Class Honours degree (or equivalent) in the Biomedical Sciences. A Master’s degree in a Neuroscience related subject is also desirable.

notes: Apply to 'Clinical Medicine Research (Brain Sciences)' on My Imperial, then email researchdegreeenquiries@imperial.ac.uk to confirm. President's Scholarship applicants need a UK First or equivalent (and a Distinction in any master's).
